missed_qualifications: The disclosure claims incorrectly say footnote 1 is absent. Unit db43e253bea18.u27.7511 supplies it, including: "all key features and risks of the fund shall be highlighted prominently in a succinct manner for investors."

Section 103 authorisation concerns authorisation of the issue, not merely authorisation of the underlying fund: "unless the SFC has authorised the issue or an exemption applies." (db43e253bea18.u9.1940). These exceptions are not stated to excuse the gift restriction.

For node.968dbccb08282a4e8a580ae5 and node.bca408c75cbf8467afafada6, offer-level aggregation should preserve the promotional link of the gift itself: "If gifts are offered in such a way that they are linked to a particular type of investment product" (db43e253bea18.u13.2987). A product-linked offer plus an unrelated gift component does not alone establish that connection.

Disclosure and attribution evidence inform component identification, but do not settle gift classification: "as they may be considered a gift" (db43e253bea18.u12.2646). Neither disclosure compliance nor an absence of misleading presentation is stated to exempt an otherwise prohibited gift.
